book.title: 我可以和你们一起玩吗？
book.subtitle: 操场上的勇敢敲门声

moral.zh: 可以开口邀请，也可以表达等待时的失落；一起商量轮流，不必用玩具或本领换取朋友。
moral.en: We can ask to join and share how waiting feels. Friendship does not need to be earned with toys or skills.

pages.zhText: 户外游戏开始了。阳光把塑胶跑道照得暖烘烘的，微风吹着大树的绿叶，孩子们走向喜欢的游戏区。
pages.enText: Outdoor play began. Sunshine warmed the running track, and leaves rustled in the breeze as the children went to their chosen play areas.

pages.zhText: 安安手里拿着两辆自己心爱的小汽车：一辆红色小跑车，一辆黄色工程救援车。她快步来到大沙坑旁。
pages.enText: An'an held two favorite toy cars in her hands: a little red roadster and a yellow tow truck. She hurried over to the sandpit.

pages.zhText: 大沙坑边上热闹非凡。小宇和天天正蹲在沙堆前，忙得热火朝天。
pages.enText: The sandpit was bustling. Xiaoyu and Tiantian knelt by a large sand mound, completely absorbed in their project.

pages.enText: They shaped damp sand into a towering fortress, rimmed with dry twigs that looked like sturdy palace ramparts.

pages.zhText: “这里需要一个大车库，可是沙子总往下塌！”天天一边挖洞一边着急地说。
pages.enText: “We need a garage tunnel here, but the sand keeps tumbling down!” Tiantian said anxiously as he dug.

pages.zhText: 安安停在三步远的地方，看着他们那么投入，心里特别想加入他们一起玩。
pages.enText: An'an stopped three paces away. Watching them play with such excitement, she wished deeply to join the adventure.

pages.zhText: 可她的脚像生了根一样停在原地，手指紧紧捏着小黄车，心想：“他们玩得那么高兴，会不会嫌我麻烦？”
pages.enText: Her feet seemed rooted to the ground. Gripping the yellow car tightly, she thought: “Will they think I'm getting in the way?”

pages.zhText: 乐乐拍着皮球从旁边路过，看见安安在沙坑边转圈，跑过来问：“安安，你怎么站在这里发呆呀？”
pages.enText: Lele bounced his basketball by. Seeing An'an circling the sandpit, he ran over: “An'an, why are you just standing here?”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium shot: Lele in mustard sweatshirt holds rubber ball, looking quizzically at An'an; sandpit visible behind them.

pages.zhText: “我想和他们一起搭城堡，但我不敢过去说。”安安低着头小声说。
pages.enText: “I want to build castles with them, but I'm afraid to go over and ask,” An'an whispered, looking down at her sneakers.

pages.enText: “You can ask whether they would like to play together,” Lele said. “Your cars could join the story, or you could simply bring an idea.”

pages.enText: The two boys looked up with sandy cheeks and smiled at her kind words. “Really? We have been building for quite a while!”

pages.enText: An'an crouched and lifted her yellow truck. “May I play with you? I would like to help make a road so the rescue truck can enter the castle.”

pages.enText: Xiaoyu's eyes widened and he clapped with glee: “Awesome! We were just wishing for a bridge! Come on over, Chief Engineer!”

pages.enText: Tiantian handed a mini plastic shovel to An'an: “You can dig the west canal, and we'll pave a smooth road for your truck!”

pages.enText: An'an learned she could ask to join and say how waiting felt. Talking with friends and asking a teacher for help could keep the game going.

parentGuide.goal: 提供实用的社交介入语言与合作策略，建立面对拒绝时的心理弹性。
parentGuide.reminder: 不把玩具、夸奖或帮忙当作获得友谊的交换条件。公共游戏空间由成人协助轮换，不让先到的孩子长期排斥他人；被拒绝时允许难过，持续排斥应向可信成人求助。
questions: 安安怎样把“我想一起玩”说了出来？
游戏需要轮流时，怎样让大家都有机会？
parentGuide.activity: 角色扮演操场社交：孩子扮演想加入游戏的小伙伴，练习带着玩具或新玩法礼貌询问。

ageTips.age4to5: 允许孩子用指图、点头、手势等非语言方式表达；共读以倾听、感受安抚为主，不强求马上做到。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论大班一日生活中的真实感受与解决策略，鼓励孩子自己提出小行动，家长承担托底支持与陪伴责任。
